text: APPROVE. The extraction keeps the `all:` stripping, both early exits (now `return null`), the `isTree` logic and the `HostEmbedRef` construction exactly as before, and the caller adds only non-null results. That removes the ternary, two `if`s and two boolean operators from the original method and leaves a single nested `if`, which should bring it well under 15. I couldn't see the surrounding file, so I'm assuming `HostEmbedRef` is a reference-type record and nullable annotations are enabled, which the `HostEmbedRef?` return type needs in order to build.
